runtime.notes: Stryker report framework confirms 10.0.0. Node and project Vitest were read from the surviving VM installation; original Node runtime was not recorded. Original lock is in raw archive; runnable lock changes only root metadata and pins direct ranges to their already locked versions.

knownLimits: C1 original runner stored candidate counts, not exact candidate lists. frozen-faults.json reconstructs lists from the surviving base revision and labels changes; original results remain unchanged.
Original fault corpus included test helpers in two production patches; corrected replay excludes those samples symmetrically and records reasons.
Original C1 counts combined failing assertions and failing suites. New replay counts new failed assertions after a health check and treats suite-only failures as incomplete collection.
Round4 C3 had one environmental failing test at both sides; suite-summaries.json and c3.log retain it. Raw coverage and attribution reports remain in the ignored archive.
Sampled C2 excludes static mutants, StringLiteral/ObjectLiteral/Regex operators, and five chdir test files. Static-aware hookPlanner pilot is separate evidence.
Raw whole-suite Vitest results were not copied; summaries retain original paths and SHA-256. Raw mutation reports and LCOV were copied.
No archived historical environment lock proves native dependency binary or OS equivalence. Repeat current-baseline A/B on the same implementation and runtime.
